name: Evil-Eye
doc: Evil-Eye (Gargantua's attack): the master, the main task, the hits and the sparks - an eye layout at a point of the caster, a screen flash and fade, a hit layout on each target with sparks rising from its bones, the sound; the damage to every target. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag282_evil_eye.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The main task's timeline: the sound, a screen fade, the hits, the damage at its end; the screen flash; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Eye
parts.doc: The eye layout at a point of the caster, turned with it

parts.title: Hits
parts.doc: A hit layout on each target, with sparks at its bones

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Sparks rising from the targets' bones

groups.label: Screen flash
groups.doc: Its level, then its fall over the last ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: At the main task's sound tick

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound at this tick of the main task

params.label: Fade tick
params.doc: A screen fade at this tick

params.label: Hits tick
params.doc: A hit on each target at this tick

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The main task's last tick: the damage (every target), the flash off

params.label: Level
params.doc: The screen flash's level until it falls (4096 = full white)

params.label: Fall ticks
params.doc: Over the last ticks it is (the end tick - the tick) x the next

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The eye layout plays from this tick of the main task

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: For this many ticks

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Its depth offset (negative = nearer)

params.label: Eye point
params.doc: Where on the caster: a point (x, y, z) and the caster's bone it is on (8 bytes)

params.label: Eye
params.doc: The prim-model layout of the eye (its models' animation), turned with the caster

params.label: Sparks under
params.doc: While its layout has fewer frames left than this

params.label: Sparks every
params.doc: ... and a multiple of this (at least 1)

params.label: Sparks
params.doc: This many sparks at random bones of its target (128 at most alive)

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Its layout's depth offset (negative = nearer)

params.label: Hit
params.doc: The prim-model layout of a hit (its models' animation), at its target's body

params.label: Rise
params.doc: A spark rises this much a tick

params.label: Life
params.doc: Its ticks (its flipbook frame = its tick)

params.label: Size
params.doc: Its sprite's size

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Its sprite's depth offset (negative = nearer)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook: an edited one keeps as many frames)
